nodes.text: @undrcvrbrothr I just had the rarer HMPV virus that landed me in the hospital for 5 days. I just got a clean x-ray and blood work. I'm so incredibly grateful for my health right now after being really sick. It's really making me rethink my choices on how I'm spending my time these days.

nodes.text: @jakki_jax I'm also learning to appreciate what time I have left.. as much as one can. I'll have a drink to your health today.
